title: GTA6 Rival? Ambitious PS5 Open World Ananta Gets Release Date
description: The ambitious anime open world game Ananta is launching on January 15, just weeks after GTA 6, setting up an epic finish for the PS5 generation.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Surprising Open World Contender: Hands-On With Ananta on PS5

As the current console generation races toward its twilight years, players often wonder what kind of technical marvels developers can still squeeze out of the hardware. Recently, gaming media outlet Push Square shared fresh hands-on impressions of the ultra-ambitious anime open-world game *Ananta*, and the verdict is clear: it is a remarkable project that feels almost too ambitious to be real.

### Launching Close to GTA 6

According to the official announcement, *Ananta* is officially scheduled to launch on **January 15th**. What makes this release window particularly fascinating is that it arrives just weeks after Rockstar Games' monumental *GTA 6*. This tight scheduling sets up an incredible, action-packed conclusion for the PS5 generation, giving urban sandbox enthusiasts back-to-back heavy hitters to sink their teeth into.

### Merging Anime Aesthetics with Sandbox Scale

While realistic urban sandboxes like *GTA 6* traditionally dominate conversations about scale and technical prowess, *Ananta* carves out its own unique lane by applying that same ultra-ambitious scope to a vibrant anime art style. Having spent hands-on time with the game on multiple occasions, critics continue to express disbelief that such a massive, fluid, and detailed anime open world is actually real and ready for release.

### An Exciting Era for PS5 Owners

There is no doubt that *GTA 6* commands the lion's share of the industry's attention. However, the arrival of a distinctive, high-ambition project like *Ananta* right on its heels proves that the PS5 generation's final stretch will be anything but quiet. It highlights a healthy, diverse landscape where players can experience both gritty, hyper-realistic crime dramas and expansive, beautifully stylized anime adventures within the span of a single month.

## Editor's Take

Releasing just weeks after *GTA 6* is a bold move, but *Ananta* looks fully equipped to hold its own. By combining staggering open-world ambitions with a gorgeous anime aesthetic, it offers a refreshing alternative to standard realistic sandboxes. January is shaping up to be an unforgettable month for PS5 open-world fans.
